title: Red Dead Redemption 2: Alternate Timelines
subtitle: The law is modernizing and your gang definitely is not.

achievements.title: Last Outlaw
achievements.description: Defeat every rival and survive the frontier's end.

achievements.title: Camp Keeper
achievements.description: Keep the camp fed and loyal through winter.

achievements.title: New Life
achievements.description: Abandon the gang and build an honest ranch.

winter_escape.title: Winter Escape
text: After a botched mountain robbery, your gang drags itself through blizzard country with two wagons, six grudges, and one speech-heavy leader.
The old world is ending. Railroads cut through sacred ground, telegraphs outrun horses, and bounty posters print faster than prayers.
Your camp needs food, medicine, and direction before the cold does what the law could not.

choices.label: Hunt and stabilize the camp first
Hit a supply train despite the storm

camp_morale.title: Camp Morale
text: At camp, people argue over rations, loyalty, and whether your leader's latest plan includes math.
Children need medicine, veterans need purpose, and everyone needs someone else to blame for the snow.
You can hold the family together or start preparing your own escape route.

choices.label: Support camp work and keep spirits up
Secretly stash money for a future exit

rail_ambush.title: Rail Ambush
text: You hit a railway payroll guarded by private gunmen who dress like bankers and shoot like cavalry.
The score is good, but so is the attention. Lawmen, industrial agents, and rival gangs all notice you at once.
Back in camp, your leader calls it destiny. Your sniper calls it noise.

choices.label: Double down on raids before spring
Lay low and move camp south

oilfield_offer.title: Oilfield Offer
text: A polished industrialist hires you to sabotage rival drilling rights, promising enough cash to buy a county and enough lies to govern it.
He talks about progress while paying outlaws to do his dirty work. Civilization, apparently, is mostly branding.
If you take the offer, the camp eats. If you refuse, your principles stay warm while your people do not.

tribal_crossroads.title: Tribal Crossroads
text: A tribal resistance cell asks for help against land seizures and military harassment.
Your leader wants to exploit the conflict for cover. Your conscience suggests there are lines even outlaws should not cross.
History is watching, badly written and heavily armed.

choices.label: Help the resistance and hit military supply routes
Exploit the conflict for gang profit

agency_tracks.title: Agency on the Tracks
text: Federal agents close in with train manifests, informants, and a photographer who somehow appears at every crime scene before lunch.
They offer you one deal: hand over your leader and receive immunity, land papers, and a chance to become boring.
Boring sounds better every day, which is probably how they get you.

choices.label: Stay loyal and prepare one final score
Leave now and build a legal life

last_score.title: Last Score
text: The gang's final plan targets a fortified mint convoy, a mountain pass, and probability itself.
Rain turns roads to mud. Old friendships turn to knives. The future arrives on steel rails whether you like it or not.
By dawn, you either become legend, evidence, or a farmer with unresolved trauma.

choices.label: Win the score and dominate the frontier
Sacrifice profit to get camp families out
Deliver the leader to federal agents

ending_last_outlaw.title: Last Outlaw
text: You survive the collapse and carve out a final outlaw dominion in the cracks of the modern age.
The telegraph calls you a criminal. Folk songs call you inevitable.

ending.title: Last Outlaw
ending.summary: You defeat rivals and outlast the frontier's dying era.

ending_camp_keeper.title: Camp Keeper
text: You choose people over legend, helping families escape while the gang myth burns behind you.
No songs get written, but children grow up.

ending.title: Camp Keeper
ending.summary: You save the camp at the cost of outlaw glory.

ending_new_life.title: New Life
text: You buy land, raise fences, and discover that cattle are still easier to manage than outlaws.
The horizon is quiet. For once, so are you.

ending.title: New Life
ending.summary: You leave the gang and begin a lawful ranch life.

ending_pinkerton_file.title: Pinkerton File
text: You survive by becoming a federal file number with excellent recall and questionable morals.
The government pays you in safety and insomnia.

ending.title: Pinkerton File
ending.summary: You betray the gang to survive modernization.
